Method of Attack: Downloads a second stage payload from a remote server and patches the legitimate npm package ethers with malicious code to serve as a reverse shell.
Attempts to patch several files of a legitimate locally installed npm package @ethersproject/providers with malicious code.
Impacted Systems: Locally installed npm packages, particularly ethers and @ethersproject/providers
Development environments using the affected npm packages
Attack Vector: Malicious install script (install.js) that downloads and executes additional payloads.
Patching legitimate npm packages with malicious code.
